simple.meaning: קָיָה (qâyâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to vomit.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 25:27. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָיָה (H7006) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קָיָה (qâyâh) / H7006 is traced through Jeremiah 25:27 with source-language evidence and verse context.

occurrences.englishText: “You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.” ’
